name: website_https
description: Provisions an Apache HTTPS Hello World site on Ubuntu, including packages, self-signed certificates, SSL virtual host configuration, static content, and service management.

name: poodle_fix
description: Hardens Apache SSL configuration to allow TLS 1.2 only and restarts the affected services.

name: chef_platform_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps Chef Automate and Chef Infra Server, or Chef Infra Server alone, on a virtual machine and creates Chef users and organizations.

name: compliance_verification
description: Provides Chef InSpec tests that verify SSH root-login hardening and HTTPS availability and TLS protocol behavior.
